AuthorizationCodeProperties.description: A structure containing the authorization code used in the authentication configuration.

AuthorizationCode.description: The authorization code used in the authentication configuration.

RedirectUri.description: The redirect URI where the user gets redirected to by authorization server when issuing an authorization code.

AuthenticationConfiguration.description: The authentication configuration used to connect to the connection.

ConnectionType.description: The type of the connection that needs to be created.

PythonProperties.description: Connection properties specific to the Python compute environment.

SparkProperties.description: Connection properties specific to the Spark compute environment.

ValidateCredentials.description: A flag to validate the credentials during create connection. Default is true.

OAuth2Credentials.description: A structure containing the OAuth2 credentials used in the authentication configuration.

UserManagedClientApplicationClientSecret.description: The client application client secret if the client application is user managed.

OAuth2Properties.description: A structure containing the authentication credentials in the CreateConnection request.

TokenUrl.description: The URL used in the authentication configuration.

SecurityGroupIdList.description: The security group ID list used by the connection.
